item.stem:
Kavya looks at the diagram of a rectangle $10\,\mathrm{cm}$ by $6\,\mathrm{cm}$ with a rectangular hole $4\,\mathrm{cm}$ by $3\,\mathrm{cm}$ cut from its interior. The hole does not meet the outer edge.

Which claim correctly finds the remaining area?

options.A: Call the answer the outer length $10\,\mathrm{cm}$ alone.
options.B: Add the outer rectangle area to the hole area.
options.C: Subtract the hole area from the outer rectangle area: $10\times 6 - 4\times 3$.
options.D: Use only the printed $4\times 3$ label as the remaining area.
